evidenceLegend.MEAS: Inventory arithmetic from this manifest; not an audio measurement.
evidenceLegend.EXT: External catalogue, host metadata or cited repository content.
evidenceLegend.INFERENCE: Selection judgement or provisional quality assessment; not auditioned.

method.rights: Commons licences accepted under the lead decision; PD-EU-audio is territorial. Archive requires a PD/CC URL or documented pre-1926 publication.
method.sourceChecks: All proposed Commons sources opened through audioInfo and their Commons wikitext; all proposed Archive sources opened with archive-files and metadata GETs.
method.duration: EXT: host-reported seconds, rounded to three decimals. No waveform analysis or audio audition.
method.quality: INFERENCE: provisional ratings only; no claim that noise, speed or cuts have been heard.
method.complete: EXT/INFERENCE: all named movements are available. A true value is catalogue completeness, not a bar-by-bar cut audit.
method.counts: A recording version means one interpretation of a work, including a complete multi-movement performance. Source-file counts are reported separately; existing tracks are excluded.
method.selectionCountCaveat: The requested target is interpreted as work-level recording versions, not movement MP3s. Complete Kinderszenen alone occupies thirteen files; no movements were omitted to force a 35-file cap.
